Write a SKILL.md for one exploitation technique, from the summaries of the posts that explain it.

Start with YAML front matter: name (the slug), description (one line on when an agent should use this skill) and for_tools: [core.notes.*]. Then explain the technique, the conditions it needs, how to spot it in code and how it is mitigated. Cite each post by its URL. Summarise; never reproduce a post's text.
